comparison: Completes the 5-rung causal ladder: Rung 1 pure SGD (2/13, 2 NaN) -> Rung 2 SGD+secant (4/13) -> Rung 3a SGD-G+Equil-D (5/13) -> Rung 3b SGD-G+secant+Equil-D (9/15) -> Rung 4 Equil-G+SGD-D (12/16, 1 NaN) -> Rung 5 Frob-SGD+MP+secant (9/16, 0 NS, 0 states) -> unified-v11 (16/16).
conclusion: Rung 5 (law4_frob_sgd_mp: zero-state layerwise Frobenius-normalized SGD + Marchenko-Pastur sqrt(fan_out/fan_in) + degree-0 peak_rms + Law 4 secant band; strictly O(params), 0 tensor states/param, 0 matmuls, 0 NS, 0 Adam) scores 9/16 executed PASS (7 numerical FAIL, 0 NaN/ERROR/TIMEOUT, 0 prereq-gated) on r4-occam-ablation-v1. Layerwise degree-0 Frobenius-MP + secant delivers a massive leap over pure SGD (2/13, 2 NaN) and global-secant SGD (4/13): unlocks grid100 (prec=0.9724, ctr=0.0660 — 2.1x sharper than unified-v11), five_word_joint_smoke (5/5, tv=0.0189, recon=1), gaussian1d_stability (ks=0.0301 — only SGD-family arm to pass), img_bars4 (4/4 hq=0.9688), ring16 (0.9573), both >500x Nash tasks (0.9583/0.9709), gaussian1d_smoke (0.0240), and zero_tanh_smoke (0.0031). Isolates the exact mathematical gap to Quintic NS (unified-v11 16/16): Frobenius normalization is rank-preserving so it cannot rescue 16-layer skip-free rank-1 spectral collapse (grid100_mlp16 prec=0.1565) and under-steps minor singular directions on model_ddgan_gaussian_chain (t1_q0=0.8386), anisotropic vector_unequal_mass/width (hq=0.9998/0.9836), t3_iso_scale_mass_8x (4/4 hq=0.9414, eig=0.6449), t3_iso_horizon_saddle_shift (4/4 hq=0.8984), and zero_tanh_rail_escape (mae=0.0063).
